newsitem.title: USA: US Midcontinent unleaded differentials firm.
newsitem.headline: US Midcontinent unleaded differentials firm.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded gasoline differentials firmed Wednesday, partially offsetting easing NYMEX unleaded futures, traders said.
Diesel differentials were largely unchanged on the day, leaving prices in the spot Chicago and Group Three markets to track easing front-month futures, traders said.
Group Three unleaded for prompt and later April deliveries was talked 0.25/0.50 cent over May NYMEX unleaded, with premium 3.50 cents higher.
Chicago unleaded was talked 0.25/0.50 cent a gallon over the print, with premium steady at 5.50 cents higher.
Group Three high and low sulphur differentials were steady at bids 6.0 cents a gallon over the print for prompt and later deliveries, traders said.
Chicago low sulphur diesel was bid 4.50 cents a gallon over May NYMEX unleaded for all April timings, with high sulphur talked 2.50/2.75 cents over the print, both unchanged.
